prespecified_units.measure: Relative change from baseline in UACR at 180 days in combination therapy group versus empagliflozin alone
prespecified_units.reported_label: Least squares (LS) mean ratios (with 95% CI) of change from baseline in UACR for combination therapy versus finerenone or empagliflozin alone
prespecified_units.role_evidence_quote: The primary endpoint, change in UACR (which was log-transformed given skewed distribution), was analyzed using a mixed model for repeated measures and expressed as least-squares mean ratio comparing combination therapy with each monotherapy.
prespecified_units.result_quote: For instance, in the very high risk group ( n = 462), the least squares mean ratio of combination therapy was 0.72 [95% confidence interval (CI) 0.59-0.89] compared with finerenone alone and 0.75 (95% CI 0.61-0.91) compared with empagliflozin alone.

prespecified_units.role_evidence_quote: A secondary efficacy outcome was the reduction in UACR to a prespecified threshold of >30%, which is supported by the American Diabetes Association Standards of Care as a target for therapeutic optimization [ 12 ].
prespecified_units.result_quote: Similarly, a substantial proportion of patients with simultaneous initiation of finerenone and empagliflozin experienced >30% decline in UACR from baseline to Day 180 (58.1% in the low/moderate risk, 74.2% in the high risk and 70.6% in the very high risk group).

prespecified_units.result_quote: eGFR that declined to >30% at 30 +/- 4 days after initiation of combination therapy was more common in low/moderate risk (12.1%) and high risk groups (8.2%) compared with very high risk group (4.4%).

additional_units.role_evidence_quote: A subanalysis of a phase 3 clinical trial of spironolactone in heart failure showed the antiproteinuria effects of this drug
additional_units.result_quote: A subanalysis of a phase 3 clinical trial of spironolactone in heart failure showed the antiproteinuria effects of this drug (39% placebo-adjusted reduction in albuminuria).

additional_units.reported_label: another kidney-specific composite endpoint that included a sustained >=57% decline in eGFR from baseline
additional_units.role_evidence_quote: it was associated with a significant 23% reduction in another kidney-specific composite endpoint that included a sustained >=57% decline in eGFR from baseline
additional_units.result_quote: Although there was no significant effect of finerenone on the composite kidney endpoint (equivalent to the primary endpoint of FIDELIO-DKD; the secondary endpoint in this trial), it was associated with a significant 23% reduction in another kidney-specific composite endpoint that included a sustained >=57% decline in eGFR from baseline.

additional_units.role_evidence_quote: A randomized, open-label crossover trial in patients with CKD revealed a robust additive UACR-lowering effect of combining the SGLT2i dapagliflozin with eplerenone
additional_units.result_quote: A randomized, open-label crossover trial in patients with CKD revealed a robust additive UACR-lowering effect of combining the SGLT2i dapagliflozin with eplerenone (a clinically relevant albuminuria reduction of 53% after 4 weeks).
